I am 76 years old and this half-hectare plot is rented, so I will not spend my little money on chemical fertilizer or new seed that might not pay back on land that is not mine. I will plant the cuttings I saved from last season, clear the bush with my children and grandchildren, and pull weeds by hand when the rains come. Since I never went to school and cannot read what is written on bags, and because borrowed money hurts more than a small harvest, I will not use chemicals or manure here, but I will pay young men from the village for five days of heavy digging work my old bones cannot manage.
